text:
maya: Quick check — need to enable a contract-gated flag for Acme (contract C-4432). Can we do a small canary + allowlist?

sam: Yep. What are the exact behavior changes?

maya: It's the new 'predictive-routing' toggle. Default off. When on for a tenant we route 10% of requests to the new path that uses dedicated KV cache.

li: If it's per-customer, we need an entry in the tenant_flags table and a migration that sets it to false by default. I can do the migration but want the rollout plan first.

anya: Console-wise I can provision an allowlist for Acme's account id (acct_9876) and set the gating to "contracted" so only customers with C-4432 can be opted in.

maya: Plan proposal: 1) add DB flag + migration 2) add feature flag wiring (server + client) behind a config key customer_feature_predictive_routing 3) deploy server with flag default off 4) enable allowlist for acct_9876 at 0.5% -> 10% ramp over 48h 5) monitor errors/latency 6) kill switch path ready.

sam: +1. Can you paste the kill switch endpoint?

maya: kill switch will be POST /internal/flags/kill/customer_feature_predictive_routing?acct=acct_9876 — needs admin token. We'll centralize in runbook.

li: For the migration: I'll add a new column tenant_flags->predictive_routing boolean default false and backfill no-op. Will add a feature flag key: "customer_feature_predictive_routing_v1" in code.

anya: Console: I'll create an allowlist named acme_predictive_v1 and add acct_9876. Need the exact flag key to show in UI.

maya: use key customer_feature_predictive_routing_v1 — pls confirm UI label: "Predictive routing (contracted)"

sam: Code review: ping me when the feature gate PR is up. Also, add a metric: routing.selection.v2.acme.count and .error to the telemetry so we can alert at >1% error.

li: Good call. I'll instrument selection.success and selection.error. Any latency SLO changes?

maya: SLO unchanged, but create a temporary dashboard: avg_p95_kv_read_time, route_percent, errors. We'll keep rollout at 10% if p95 < 120ms and error rate < 0.5%.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: infra/deploy -> service:inference-runtime to staging at 2325001200 by li. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/4532

maya: staging smoke tomorrow 10:00 PT. Canary to prod only after smoke + traffic tests.

anya: I'll prepare console toggle instructions and a screenshot for support.

sre-oncall: FYI — confirm we have a warmed standby for cache nodes. If the new path launches and cache warms, we might see bursts. Recommend a short pre-warm job against a replica set.

li: I'll add a prewarm job to the deploy pipeline: script -> /ops/prewarm_kv.sh --tenant acct_9876.

maya: Awesome. Action items: li (migration + PR + prewarm), sam (CR + metrics/alerts), anya (allowlist + UI label + support doc), maya (runbook + kill switch + rollout). Will post updates here.

sam: Thx. Ping me when PR is ready, I'll do an expedited review. :thumbsup:

anya: Putting a calendar invite for the staging smoke test.

maya: Closing loop — if anyone hits blockers, @maya or @sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: noted. I'll watch the dashboard during rollout and have rollback steps ready.
